verses.1: Son, keep my words and commandments.
verses.2: Hear my commandments and live by my laws, as you would see fit.
verses.3: They are written on your palms, as their names are written on your hearts.
verses.4: Say to my sister Wisdom: “Knowledge is called understanding.”
verses.5: To keep you away from a foreign woman, a woman who is not your own people. Her words have caused me to be troubled.
verses.6: For in the wilderness of my home, in the place where I was left alone, I wept.
verses.7: And suddenly, I saw my father among the children—a young man without a heart.
verses.8: He will walk across the street at her side, and along the path leading to her house.
verses.9: In the evening, on a day of darkness and gloom.
verses.10: And behold, there was a woman who called him “Zion” and said that he had a beautiful heart.
verses.11: Homyah is a house of chaos; her feet are not allowed to rest in it.
verses.12: Once in the wilderness, once in the deserts, and everywhere else as well.
verses.13: And she held it in her hands, and kissed it. Her face was filled with joy, and she said to him:
verses.14: The idols of Solomon are now in my hands; they have been destroyed today.
verses.15: Therefore, I went to call you, so that I might wash your faces clean. And I found you indeed.
verses.16: I have been punished greatly; my graves are filled with evil spirits from Egypt.
verses.17: I awoke from my sleep, and I saw tents and campfires.
verses.18: May our fathers be blessed until morning; may their hearts be filled with love.
verses.19: For the man is not in his house, walking along the road from remote places.
verses.20: The man who carried the money took it in his hands. On the day when the ark was brought into the house, he came there.
verses.21: They took her by force, and they burned her with fire.
verses.22: He suddenly follows her, as if by magic. He arrives at Tabach Yabo, and then enters Musar Ewil.
verses.23: Until the cliff falls down, like a swift shadow towards the ground… And he won’t know that it’s in his own heart that it happens.
verses.24: And now, children, listen to me and pay attention to what I say.
verses.25: Do not follow her paths in your heart; do not become lost in her ways.
verses.26: For many people, they destroyed everything and killed all those who were there.
verses.27: The paths of Shaul’s house led them down to the dungeons of death.
